selected_evidence.requirement: node2:8080 is not openly exposed beyond node1 (private-network framing)

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 can reach the published port and get node2's content

selected_evidence.requirement: Published port 80 on node1 is refused for every other source address (not just node3)
